title: Eval run · skill-evals objectstack-data + objectstack-automation × 2 arms × 1 rep · 3b4f0b98 · 2026-11-25 · #34770 before round
body:
eval#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

This is the **before** baseline for #34770, under ruling ②A (7128031203). The go is recorded at 7151479313.

The seat filed it from runner `session_01QSeKYnHookmVT2ba4DfXbG`'s report; the runner made no GitHub write. The after round must repeat the config below exactly and be diffed against the **with-skill failing set** in §3.

## Environment
- **Runner:**
  - checkout: objectstack-ai/objectstack at `3b4f0b9832836e75a8300ece68acc970d1c7adf6`, detached;
  - skills source: workspace `skills/`;
  - #36718 is on this main, so ②A's precondition holds.
- **Driver:**
  - `claude -p` from Claude Code 2.1.332, on a subscription `oauth_token` login (`apiBilled: false`), with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` unset;
  - served `claude-sonnet-5-5` on all 202 turns;
  - requested `--model sonnet --effort medium`.
- **Command:**
  - `skill-evals --skills objectstack-data,objectstack-automation --repeats 1 --model sonnet --effort medium --concurrency 4`;
  - defaults kept: `--max-turns 16`, case timeout 300 s, `--max-utilization 0.9`, `--trigger-field selection` (both bundles installed in every trigger turn).
- **Run:**
  - 202 of 202 turns ran: 94 behaviour cases × 2 arms, plus 14 trigger cases;
  - 0 not run, 0 invalid, 0 error;
  - 04:22:03Z to 04:35:48Z, 13.8 min wall.
- **Cost:**
  - the CLI's notional figure is $15.36, which is not billed;
  - the runner session cost $0.81.
- **Not available:** seven-day utilization. This CLI reports only the window status, which was `allowed` throughout. The after round will have the same gap.

## 1. Behaviour results

| bundle | cases | with-skill | no-skill | delta (pp) |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|--:|
| objectstack-automation | 29 | 24 / 29 (82.8%) | 0 / 29 (0%) | +82.8 |
| objectstack-data | 65 | 49 / 65 (75.4%) | 1 / 65 (1.5%) | +73.8 |
| **all** | 94 | **73 / 94 (77.7%)** | 1 / 94 (1.1%) | +76.6 |

Reading the no-skill arm: every case grades on literal ObjectStack API tokens. A turn in an empty directory with no skill can't know them, so near-zero is the expected floor, not a defect. The no-skill pass is `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#31`.

## 2. Trigger results
14 of 14 passed:
- **Should load:** 10 of 10, all through the `Skill` tool.
- **Should be left alone:** 4 of 4.
- **Missed and false loads:** 0 each.

Two should-not cases pulled in the other bundle, `automation/triggers#6` → data and `data/triggers#6` → automation. Neither loaded its own bundle, so both pass.

## 3. With-skill failing set: the parity baseline (21)
Case ids are `bundle/file#id`. M means a `must_contain` token was missed; F means a `must_not_contain` token was carried.

**objectstack-automation (5)**
- `flows-triggers-approvals#5`: F `label: 'error'`
- `flows-triggers-approvals#11`: F `runAs: 'system'`
- `flows-triggers-approvals#14`: M `record-after-update`, `trigger record`; F `sourceObject:`, `actionUrl:`
- `flows-triggers-approvals#16`: M `notices.`, `type: 'approval'`
- `integrations-declared#1`: M `defineConnector`, `/connection`

**objectstack-data (16)**
- `hooks-security-seeds-datasources`:
  - `#3`: M `OS_DATASOURCE_ENV_CREDENTIALS`
  - `#4`: F `new Date(`
  - `#6`: M `permissionSets`
  - `#8`: M `type: 'queue'`
  - `#15`: M `defaultValue: 'current_user'`
  - `#16`: F `permissions:`
  - `#19`: M `permissionSets: ['hd_agent']`, `dependencies: {`
  - `#20`: M `function: 'count'`
  - `#34`: M `refused`
- `objects-fields-relationships`:
  - `#2`: M `type: 'user'`
  - `#8`: M `sharingModel: 'private'`
  - `#11`: M `type: 'select'`
  - `#12`: M `type: 'summary'`, `type: 'formula'`
  - `#20`: F `defaultCurrency: 'USD'`
  - `#22`: M `unitConfig`, `unitMode`, `H87`, `KGM`
  - `#24`: M `sys_exchange_rate`

**No-skill failing set:** all 94 behaviour cases except `objectstack-data/hooks-security-seeds-datasources#31` (93). The runner's report holds the missed tokens for each; they are left out here, because parity reads the with-skill arm.

## 4. How the after round compares (ruling ②A)
- **Config:** the same flags, with `--skills objectstack-data,objectstack-automation`, on the #34770 PR's finalized head, after `main` is merged in.
- **"Not lower":** the with-skill failing set is the same 21 cases, or a subset of them.
- **Flips:** a case that flips in either direction is re-run once (`--filter` on that case), and its second reading counts.
- **Triggers:** they stay at 14 of 14. A trigger regression is reported beside the parity reading, not inside it.

## 5. Anomalies
- **Exit code:** not captured, because the runner ran detached. `round.json` shows `ranTurns 202 / notRunTurns 0`, so no quota stop fired.
- **Round files:** the runner's scratchpad is archived with the session. This record's §1 to §3 carry everything the after round needs.

Security: none. Leak check: no account or private values in the report.
